scope: One fixed existing-private-capsule catalog projection, followed only after its authoritative closure by three fixed public file_info observations. SDK execution and public body admissions are not included.

public_infos.on_oversize_helper: Preserve actual metadata and stop; do not admit body or claim that completed metadata hashing was bounded by the proposed body cap.
public_infos.next_step: After three infos close, freeze exact version-bound body requests; maximum5 operations, <=65536 each, total accepted whole bodies <=265740. Present actual bindings to root for body GO.

execution_protocol: Complete a separate external execution intent containing the exact catalog request before submitting it once.
Save and verify the original SDK ACK externally in full before examining isError or parsing native text. Preserve unsafe integers losslessly.
Use only the returned original job for terminal authority and original stream reads; wait <=30 seconds, immutable pages only for each original observer.
Require exit0, no timeout/cancel, output_complete/output_durable/terminal_publication_confirmed and whole public stdout+stderr; projection guards and exact private input hash remain authoritative.

Only after all original catalog observers are completed/stored/inactive may the first public info be submitted. For each info, external exact intent first, one original request, full original SDK before parsing, original-ID closure and all immutable pages before the next.

Any error, missing ACK, guard refusal, timeout or UNKNOWN stops further admissions. Preserve original response; no implicit retry, new business key, reset, alias fallback, widened deadline, new fixture or provider call.
not_authorized: root scans or following new imports
body requests before root reviews actual versions
